findings.body: With `checks = ["tests", "tests (windows-latest)"]`, a successful Windows check matches both requirements, but `next()` assigns it only to `tests`. The explicitly named Windows group remains empty, so close times out reporting a missing check even when every check succeeded. Populate every matching requirement while retaining validation of unnamed checks, and add a regression case with overlapping configured names.
findings.title: Count each check toward every matching requirement
